summary.intent: Fix failing web and desktop E2E tests on PR #449 (fix/desktop-e2e-sequence-mismatch), which were traced to regressions introduced by the previously merged PR #448 (IPNS publish flow changes).
summary.outcome: Web E2E tests were fixed (175/176 passing, 1 remaining flaky Sapphire Devnet login). Desktop E2E was fixed for Linux and Windows; macOS required additional FUSE drain trigger workarounds. A final CI run (24025204612) was kicked off with the corrected Windows script.

repo: PR #448 introduced hard-failing signature verification in the web IPNS service that crashed vault initialization when protobuf parsing inconsistencies occurred between the ipns npm package and the custom API parser.
The IPNS record parser throws on deprecated protobuf wire types 3/4 (start/end group), causing delegated routing resolve to fail and fall back to DB cache — masked the real error.

Desktop FUSE publish pipeline: after release() spawns a background IPFS upload, drain_upload_completions() must be called by a subsequent FUSE callback (lookup/getattr/readdir) to process completions. In CI on macOS/Linux, no ambient FUSE events fire after the write, so the pipeline stalls.

macOS FUSE-T uses an SMB backend that caches directory listings — a single post-write ls may not reach the FUSE layer; stat on the specific file via lookup is more reliable and must be repeated in the polling loop.

Windows desktop E2E was already passing with the commit at 5670444208c8cedd8d6e867a2f81a9f31068f520 (timeout doubled, one-time Get-ChildItem drain); adding per-iteration Get-Item/Get-ChildItem broke it.

91 skipped tests were entirely a cascade from 5 setup failures — the actual unique root causes were 3 wallet login timeouts, 1 media upload failure, 1 recovery IPNS resolution failure, and 2 potentially flaky tests.
The Sapphire Devnet 'timesigned is more than 6m0s ago' / 'Error occurred while getting current epoch' alert is a known flaky env issue unrelated to IPNS changes.

code.finding: Hard-throwing signature verification on IPNS resolve was introduced in PR #448. Wrapping in try/catch so failures warn-and-continue (returning signatureVerified: false) prevents vault init crashes.
Parser threw on protobuf wire types 3 (start group) and 4 (end group) which are deprecated but valid. Changed to skip them gracefully.

macOS/Linux readdir handler was missing drain_upload_completions() call that Windows dir_ops.rs:32 already had. Without it, upload completions queue up after release() but never get processed in CI where no ambient FUSE events occur.
rmdir handler did not clean up publish_queue entries for the removed inode, causing 'Folder inode not found' errors on flush when a queued folder was deleted before publish fired.
Added stat + ls on the mount point inside every polling iteration to force FUSE lookup → drain_upload_completions on each poll cycle, not just once after write.
Correct state is commit 5670444208c8: timeout doubled to 24 attempts, one-time Get-ChildItem drain after write. Per-iteration drain (added later) broke Windows and was reverted.

workflow: Always run a full pnpm build of all packages before starting dev servers — crypto package (and potentially others) must be built first or servers fail to start.
When E2E test suites have setup tests, a single setup failure cascades to skip the entire suite — always distinguish unique root failures from skip cascades before triaging.
git checkout <branch> -- <file> restores a file to a specific branch state; git show <commit>:<file> > <file> restores to a specific commit.
CI timeline analysis (checking run history before and after suspected PRs) is an effective way to pinpoint which PR introduced a regression.
Force-pushing an amended commit does not cancel an already-running CI job — a manual cancel + re-trigger is needed.

friction: Local dev environment was down (PostgreSQL/Redis at 192.168.133.12 unreachable), preventing local E2E re-runs and forcing reliance on CI for validation.
Long investigation chasing the 'Error occurred while getting current epoch' Sapphire alert as a root cause before it was clarified as irrelevant env noise.
GitHub CLI OAuth token expired mid-session, blocking CI log fetching.
macOS FUSE-T SMB caching meant a single post-write ls was insufficient to reliably trigger the FUSE readdir drain — required multiple iterations of stat calls.
Restoring the Windows PS1 script required two attempts: first incorrectly restored from main (losing timeout increases), then correctly restored from the specific passing commit.
Force-pushing an amended commit while CI was already running on the old commit caused a wasted run.
open_items: Desktop E2E macOS fix relies on stat calls in the test polling loop to trigger FUSE drain — the underlying issue (drain_upload_completions not being called automatically after release() in ambient-event-free environments) may need a more robust fix, such as a background drain timer in the FUSE daemon.
The remaining 1/176 web E2E failure (batch-download or media-preview, rotates per run) is a known Sapphire Devnet wallet login flake — no fix applied, accepted as environmental.
recovery.spec.ts was skipped entirely during investigation (IPFS-direct v2 blob path recovery, empty progress log) — root cause not confirmed.
The conflict-detection and full-workflow breadcrumb failures from the initial run were not definitively root-caused — they passed on re-run, suggesting flakiness, but not confirmed.
CI run 24025204612 was the final state at session end — results not yet confirmed.
